scope: Change only pose based on user photo; retain corrected paired mandibles and card design.

Asset type: existing Ashborne Ace of Diamonds card, POSE-ONLY revision.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and binding source for this exact creature design, correct paired mandibles, materials, palette, rendering, card layout, background and lettering.
Input image 2 is a POSE reference ONLY. Use the alert fighting posture of the real beetle: abdomen low, forebody reared up, lifted head and open mandibles, legs braced. Its captions, watermark, black lower band, photo palette and environment are irrelevant; do not copy them.

USER REQUEST: The user likes the corrected creature. Change ONLY its posture to a threatening combat-ready stance similar to image 2. Do not redesign it.

Repose the SAME blue aquamarine and antique-gold armored stag beetle in the existing stream. Keep the posterior abdomen low toward the right, raise the thorax and head markedly upward toward the upper-left, forming an obvious diagonal axis from low right abdomen to high left head. The opened pincer points diagonally forward/up, held as a threat display. Neck is stretched naturally, not humanoid. Middle and hind legs spread and plant firmly on the existing rocks/streambed to brace its weight; the front pair are flexed and lifted slightly in a poised challenge. Six insect legs total, intact joints, readable contact and weight, no additional limbs. This must read as a beetle rearing to confront an opponent, clearly different from the previous level walking pose.
Keep both mandibular roots on opposing left/right FRONT corners of the broad head, mirrored paired stag mandibles in the same anatomical plane, curved inward tips and teeth along inside edges. Preserve the corrected head and mandible DESIGN from image 1 while rotating them with the new pose. No vertical upper/lower jaws, no forehead horn. Keep the same two segmented antennae. Entire creature and tips stay inside the picture frame. Maintain overall scale and balance.

STRICT INVARIANTS: Same exact creature identity, shell plates and proportions, slate-blue/aquamarine chitin, muted gold seams, cyan eye, matte hand-painted 2D color-plane style, lighting, stream, ruined arches, distant statues and landscape. Repaint only creature pose and the minimum local background/ground contact exposed by moving it. Do not add enemies, weapons, armor ornaments, glow, speed lines, effects, labels or objects.
Preserve ALL card interface pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible: portrait 2:3 canvas, ivory parchment, border, corners, bronze illustration frame, diamond clasp, red diamond and A indices, navy title ribbon, rules box, typography, exact Vietnamese lettering, their placement, sizes and line breaks. Title "Giáp Hươu Mạch Suối"; category "Ấn Khai Dạng · Nước"; text "Khai Dạng trong lượt này. Đòn vũ khí đầu tiên hồi một ít HP. Lượng hồi tăng nếu bạn mất HP ở lượt địch vừa qua." No other changes.
